statement: Anthropic's annualized revenue is reported to have exceeded $65 billion, with OpenAI's above $40 billion as of July 2026.
why: Revenue at this run-rate is the cash engine that makes the compute commitments fundable, so it underwrites the durability of accelerator demand rather than just the announcement of it.

impact.mechanism: Higher model-vendor revenue funds continued inference and training capacity purchases, sustaining orders for accelerators and cloud capacity.

evidence.excerpt: Anthropic's annualized revenue reportedly exceeded $65 billion; OpenAI's exceeded $40 billion as of July 2026.

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet, figure flagged as reported rather than disclosed by the company.
